subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Unbiased
solution:
The correct answer is: **Objective**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Objective **means unbiased, not influenced by personal feelings or opinions.
 
• Other synonyms of unbiased include impartial, neutral, fair, and even-handed.
 
 
• **For example**: The judge made an objective
